notes.title: The Grand Lord OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Thank you for your interest and we hope you give the game a chance! We spent a long time working on it and had many enjoyable moments that we hope will come across in the game. 

Please let us know if there are any bugs or issues you encounter. We've made a pinned post in the community section where you can do that. Or, engage with us and let us know what endings you received!
